digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / llm agent-call runaway guard + memo composition
propositions: The runaway guard observes every tool call before the memo layer answers it, so memo-served cache hits are counted as loop evidence and trip RunawayToolLoopError despite being zero-cost operations.
Reads past the memo cache window fall back to uncached exact-range reads, degrading the distinct-ratio further and causing false loop trips on legitimate verifier patterns.

A shared ToolCallLedger between guard and memo layers enables the guard to count only EXECUTED (not memo-served) calls for the distinct-ratio arm and use a served-streak backstop to bound pure cache-served loops.

Guard recomposition preserves layer order (Guard→Memo→Steering), completion-policy visibility, and existing runaway-guard semantics for genuine loops while eliminating false trips on memoized repeats.

The guard's two-arm design (ratio arm over executed calls only, served-streak arm for full-window zero-execution backstop) prevents memo-served repeats from resetting the streak and falsely triggering arm 2.
